Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then Moses assembled the congregation of the sons of Israel, and said to them: 'These are the things which God has commanded that they be done.'
translations.2: Six days shall the crafts be done, but on the seventh day it shall be for you a holy thing — a rest, a Sabbath to God. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
translations.3: You shall not kindle fire in any of your dwellings on the day of the Sabbath.
translations.4: And Moses said to the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: 'This is the thing which God has commanded.'
translations.5: Bring from what you have a contribution to God; let everyone whose heart is willing bring a contribution to God — gold, and silver, and copper,
translations.6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and fine linen, and fine wool,
translations.7: and rams' hides of tanned leather, and hides of tachash, and acacia wood,
translations.8: and oil for giving light, and spices for the anointing oil, and incense of resins,
translations.9: and crystal stones, and stones for setting — for the breastpiece and for the vestment.
translations.11: the tabernacle and its tent and its covering, and its clasps, and its planks, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases,
translations.12: and the ark and its poles, and the cover, and the concealing curtain,
translations.13: and the table and its poles and all its vessels, and the facing bread,
translations.14: and the lampstand of light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for giving light,
translations.15: and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil, and the incense of resins, and the curtain of the entrance of the tent of the tabernacle,
translations.16: and the altar of offerings, and the copper grating that belongs to it, and its poles, and all its vessels, and the laver and its base,
translations.17: and the curtains of the court, and their pillars and their bases, and the curtain of its gate,
translations.18: and the pegs of the tabernacle, and the pegs of the court, and their cords,
translations.19: and the embroidered garments for service in the sanctuary, and the holy garments for Aaron the imām, and the garments of his sons for the imāmate.'
translations.20: And the congregation of the sons of Israel went out from before Moses.
translations.21: And there came every man whose heart was willing, and every one who had a vision — with a contribution to God, for the making of the tent of the assembly and for all its work, and for the holy garments.
translations.22: There came after that the men together with the women — those among them who were generous — bringing even bracelets and earrings, and signet rings and girdles, and the rest of the vessels of gold; and everyone who set apart a separation of gold for God.
translations.23: And everyone in whose possession there was found blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and fine linen, and fine wool, and rams' hides of tanned leather, and hides of tachash — they brought them.
translations.24: And everyone who raised a contribution to God of silver and copper brought it to God; and everyone in whose possession there was acacia wood — for any part of the making of the work — brought it.
translations.25: And every woman skilled enough to spin with her hand came with spun work of blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and fine linen.
translations.26: And every woman outstanding in her skill spun the fine wool.
translations.27: And the nobles brought the crystal stones, and the stones for setting — for the breastpiece and for the vestment.
translations.28: And the spices, and the oil for giving light, and the anointing oil, and the incense of resins.
translations.29: Thus every man and woman whose heart was willing to bring something for all the craftsmanship which God had commanded to be done by the hand of Moses — the sons of Israel brought it as a freewill offering to God.
translations.30: And Moses said to the sons of Israel: 'See that God has honored Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
translations.31: and has perfected in him knowledge from God — in wisdom, and understanding, and skill in all craftsmanship —
translations.32: and proficient in the trades, in the craft of gold, and silver, and copper,
translations.33: and in the engraving of gems for setting, and in the carpentry of wood, and in doing all the rest of the crafts of the trades.
translations.34: And for teaching He has placed in his hand — he and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan —
translations.35: He has perfected in their hearts the knowledge of wisdom, that they may make every craft of a master and expert, and an embroiderer in blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and fine linen, and a weaver; for the two of them are craftsmen of every craft, and proficient in the trades.'
